notes: AI unit-hours are exact: ai_units (shapes.json) * unit_count * hours. That number is
derived entirely from Oracle's published shape table and needs no price to be correct.
The dollar rate is NOT auto-verified. Oracle moved per-SKU Generative AI prices behind
the interactive cost estimator, so there is no stable public page or API to read it
from. Rather than ship an invented number dressed up as Oracle's, the rate below is a
placeholder the user is expected to replace with their contracted rate; the UI exposes
it as an editable field and labels any dollar figure derived from it as unverified.
Imported models are exempt from the 744 unit-hour hosting minimum that applies to

price_per_ai_unit_hour.label: Placeholder rate — replace with your contracted AI unit/hour price
